<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/discounts"}
#docs
Its duration counts the invoices it discounts: `once` discounts the next one, `repeating` the next `duration_in_periods`, `forever` every invoice until you remove it. The business setting `billing_rules_config.customer_coupons` sets how it combines with other coupons: `fallback` (the default) applies it only to an invoice that no other coupon discounts; `stack` adds it to the other coupons. A fixed-amount coupon does not discount an invoice in another currency. A coupon can be active on a customer only once.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | Customer id (cus_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `coupon` | `string` | **yes** | The coupon code, or a code from a coupon set. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `customer_discount`. One of `customer_discount`. |
| `id` | `string` | The customer discount id. |
| `coupon` | `string` | The coupon code. |
| `coupon_name` | `string` | The coupon's name. |
| `kind` | `string` | The customer discount's kind. One of `percentage`, `fixed_amount`. |
| `percent_off_bps` | `integer` | The percentage off, in basis points. |
| `amount_off_minor` | `integer` | The fixed amount off, in minor units. |
| `currency` | `string` | The currency of a fixed amount. Invoices in other currencies get no discount. |
| `apply_on` | `string` | The customer discount's apply on. One of `invoice_amount`, `each_specified_item`. |
| `duration_type` | `string` | The customer discount's duration type. One of `once`, `repeating`, `forever`. |
| `remaining_invoices` | `integer` | How many more invoices it discounts. Null: every invoice until removed. |
| `total_invoices` | `integer` | How many invoices it discounts in total. Null: no limit. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the customer discount was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Coupon applied |
| `400` | Coupon not usable: unknown, archived, expired, at its redemption limit, or already applied to this customer |
| `404` | No such customer |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/discounts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "coupon": "welcome-10"
  }'
```
